title: BMCP Unified COC / JF-10 / Provider Outcome Protocol 1.2.10
description: Schema artifact revision 1.2.10. Preserves the typed canonical union of COC participants and unregistered I/D/C owner-local admissions, exact owner snapshot-root/attestation/membership-proof binding, distinct manifest content/member-set/record digests, and on-wire protocol-family version 1.3.0. Normalizes the owner outage release enum to OUTAGE_ADMISSION_RELEASE_ONLY across I/D/C. signature_profile_id remains structurally optional only for explicitly non-protected compatibility records; protected owner-signed records require it semantically. Completeness, digest equality, quorum order, signature projection and owner authority remain semantic-validator responsibilities.

owner_snapshots.description: Exactly one signed owner snapshot per authority. Object keys are owner identities; validator requires each nested owner field to equal its key.

manifest_content_digest.description: ParticipantManifestContentDigest over the canonical union projection, prefix and frozen owner snapshot roots; excludes the later Batch backlink, quorum proof and envelope.

owner_local_admission_count.description: Count of unregistered OWNER_LOCAL_ADMISSION members only.

manifest_member_count.description: Total union member count; equals coc_participant_count plus owner_local_admission_count.

member_set_root.description: Canonical ordered root over every typed union member.

manifest_content_digest.description: ParticipantManifestContentDigest over the canonical union projection, prefix and frozen owner snapshot roots; excludes the later Batch backlink, quorum proof and envelope.

member_set_root.description: Canonical ordered root over every typed union member.

manifest_members.description: Canonical union of every COC participant at/before P and every applicable I/D/C owner-local admission at/below its frozen high-water. Joined admissions are bindings on the COC member; unregistered admissions are separate OWNER_LOCAL_ADMISSION members.

release_type.description: Owner-local release of the temporary outage admission gate only; it does not clear Forget effectiveness, grant I permission or authorize C egress.

manifest_content_digest.description: ParticipantManifestContentDigest; not the final committed manifest-record entry digest.
ParticipantManifestContentDigest; not the final committed manifest-record entry digest.

schema_version.description: Protocol-family wire version 1.3.0. Schema artifact revision 1.2.9 is identified by $id. The wire version is incremented because the manifest union and digest fields are breaking changes.

canonicalization_profile_id.description: Exact versioned canonicalization profile identifier; candidate until approved by the relevant authority.

key_id_ref.description: Authenticated issuer/owner key reference; never key material and never trusted from payload alone.

signature_profile_id.description: Exact owner/authority signature profile identifier. Required by semantic validation for signed owner records; not inferred from canonicalization_profile_id.

commonEnvelope.description: Common authenticated message envelope. Artifact revision 1.2.8; the on-wire protocol-family schema_version remains 1.2.0. Signature profile is explicit when present; semantic validation requires it for protected owner-signed records.

admission_high_water.description: Owner-local admission ledger high-water, distinct from request_high_water.

owner_snapshot_attestation_digest.description: Digest of the immutable owner-signed snapshot attestation resolved by owner_snapshot_attestation_ref.

owner_specific_high_waters_digest.description: Digest of the complete owner-specific high-water object under the approved canonical profile.

owner_snapshot_membership_proof_digest.description: Digest of the exact owner-ledger membership proof, bound to the frozen snapshot root and entry identity.
Digest of the exact owner-ledger membership proof, bound to the frozen snapshot root and entry identity.

provider_idempotency_key_ref.description: Provider idempotency key reference; never the secret value

owner_admission_bindings.description: Zero or more exact owner-local admissions already joined to this COC participant. If an applicable frozen owner admission exists, it must appear exactly once; if none exists, the array is explicitly empty.
